title: Adding slow magnetoacoustic mode to the HLL-type multi-state approximate Riemann solution
summary: Multi-state HLL-type approximate Riemann solutions of ideal magnetohydrodynamics (MHD) typically assume that the medium within the Riemann fan is incompressible, and thus the slow magnetoacoustic mode cannot be included in their space-time wave configurations for the approximated states. We propose a new strategy to design multi-state HLL-type approximate solutions, allowing for the medium within the Riemann fan to be compressible.
